praise.title: Imana y'Ubuntu
praise.chorus:
Tuzamuhimbaze, tuzamuhimbaze,
Imana y'ubuntu ku isi yose.
stanzas:
Imana y'ubuntu, tuzamuhimbaze,
ku bw'urukundo rwayo rudashira.

Twese hamwe, twese hamwe,
turamuhe icyubahiro.

praise.title: Murakoze Imana
stanzas:
Murakoze Imana yacu,
ku bw'ubuntu bwawe bwinshi.

praise.title: Uwiteka ni Umwungeri
praise.chorus:
Uwiteka ni umwungeri wanjye,
sinzabura icyo nkeneye.
stanzas:
Uwiteka ni umwungeri wanjye,
sinzabura icyo nkeneye.

Anyamika ku byatsi bishyushye,
anderekeza ku mazi atuje.

praise.title: Halleluya
praise.chorus:
Halleluya, Halleluya,
Imana yacu ni nziza.
stanzas:
Halleluya, Halleluya,
Imana yacu ni nziza.

salvation.title: Yesu ni Umwami
salvation.chorus:
Yesu ni Umwami, Yesu ni Umwami,
ni we Murokora w'isi yose.
stanzas:
Yesu ni Umwami w'ijuru n'isi,
ni we Murokora wacu.

Tuvuge amasezerano ye,
hari mu isi yose.

salvation.title: Ijwi ryiza ryanyu
salvation.chorus:
Nimwumve ijwi ry'Umwami,
ryiza, ryiza, rituma ndohoka.
stanzas:
Ijwi ryiza ryanyu, Yesu,
ryampamagariye iwawe.

Nimwumve ijwi ry'Umwami,
mu byishimo n'urukundo.

salvation.title: Umucyo w'isi
salvation.chorus:
Yesu ni umucyo w'isi,
tugende mu mucyo we.
stanzas:
Yesu ni umucyo w'isi,
ukira mu mwijima.

Tugende mu mucyo we,
kugira ngo tuzabone.

salvation.title: Nzaguma hafi yawe
salvation.chorus:
Nzaguma hafi yawe, Yesu,
iminsi yose y'ubugingo.
stanzas:
Nzaguma hafi yawe, Yesu,
mu byishimo no mu kubabara.
